bugs.error_message: Anime episodes show 0 cached and 0 cloud Real-Debrid sources (movies/TV fine; Seren shows 20-40 cached)
bugs.root_cause: TorrentCacheCheck only ran the external RD cache lookup (DMM/Torrentio/Comet/AIOStreams) when an IMDb id was present; anime from Simkl often has none, so nothing was checked and every hash was written as uncached for 4 h. Cloud: anime names like '[Group] Show - 05' and batch torrents '(01-28)' never matched the SxxEyy/unpadded matchers.
bugs.fix: Kitsu-id contexts (kitsu:<id> via MAL/AniList mapping) for Torrentio/Comet/AIOStreams; Seren-style unverified RD fallback for anime with no ids; anime zero-padded episode matcher; anime batch handling in the RD cloud scraper (commit ce0d509, release 5.0.57)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.57, not yet confirmed inside Kodi; did not fix the user's Lord of Mysteries report (different cause: bug-002, bug-003)

bugs.error_message: Every Real-Debrid torrent for 'Lord of Mysteries' S01E01 shown as uncached in 5.0.57 (Seren 3.0.62 shows many cached); DMM availability check returns 403 {"errorMessage":"Authentication error"} for every IMDb id
bugs.root_cause: _dmm_get_secret signed the DMM availability token client-side with a hard-coded salt. DMM moved token signing server-side on 2026-08-31 (GET /api/challenge -> {token, hash}), so every DMM call (RD and AD) returned 403. The error was swallowed as an empty set, silently removing the only per-hash cache checker for all movies, TV and anime; mainstream titles were masked by the Torrentio/Comet/AIOStreams crowd caches. Only the first 100 hashes were ever sent.
bugs.fix: _dmm_get_challenge fetches the token from /api/challenge (shared across threads under a lock, reused 110 s, one forced refetch on 403 in _dmm_post_chunk, 30 s back-off after a failed challenge); hashes sent in chunks of 100; dead client-side signing helpers removed (release 5.0.58)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.58 (49a0a40), not yet confirmed inside Kodi

bugs.error_message: Hashes whose cache check failed or got no answer were stored as uncached ('False') in debridCache for 4 h and not rechecked; the unverified fallback never applied to items with an IMDb or Kitsu id
bugs.root_cause: Every external checker returned set() on exception and _run_parallel_checks counted that as a completed check, so 'failed' looked like 'none cached'. _realdebrid_worker / _all_debrid_worker then wrote every unconfirmed hash as 'False' (even when success was False). The ce0d509 unverified fallback only fired for anime with neither IMDb nor Kitsu id. Negatives written by older versions also blocked rechecks, and _split_by_db_cache compared hashes case-sensitively.
bugs.fix: Checkers return None for no answer and set() only for a real answer; check_rd_external / check_ad_external return (cached, success, dmm_checked); _write_cache_results(checked_hashes=dmm_checked) persists 'False' only for hashes DMM answered for; _offer_unanswered_rd_torrents offers the rest as unverified=True (label 'REAL DEBRID (UNVERIFIED)', string #31129, sorted last by source_sorter._get_cache_confidence_key); DebridCache.clear_uncached_entries runs on every version change; hashes compared lower-case; scraper debrid RD/AD markers honoured (release 5.0.58)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.58 (49a0a40), not yet confirmed inside Kodi

bugs.error_message: Comet RD check returned no hashes: the first Comet base answered HTTP 200 with only an 'Invalid API key' error stream and the remaining bases were never tried
bugs.root_cause: comet_check_cache left the base loop on the first 2xx response. Comet reports problems such as an invalid debrid key as a 200 with a single '[X] realdebrid' error stream, so the error looked like 'nothing cached' and the other bases were skipped.
bugs.fix: _is_comet_error_stream filters error streams; an error-only answer is logged and the next base is tried; no real answer from any base returns None (no answer) instead of set() (release 5.0.58)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.58 (49a0a40), not yet confirmed inside Kodi

bugs.error_message: TV season packs named like 'Show.S01.1080p' never matched at torrent level in the cloud scrapers (pre-existing, inherited from Seren)
bugs.root_cause: get_filter_season_pack_fn built the suffix f"s%{season_fill}" with a literal '%', which can never match, so only 's1' / 'season 1' forms were recognised.
bugs.fix: Season suffix regex (?:s|season ?)0*N(?![a-z0-9]) with an optional show-year prefix, so season 1 no longer matches s10 / s011; video-file titles are never treated as season packs (release 5.0.58; 41/41 offline cases)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.58 (49a0a40), not yet confirmed inside Kodi

bugs.error_message: AIOStreams cache check against aiostreams.vortetos.com fails with NameResolutionError on every call
bugs.root_cause: The public AIOStreams instance aiostreams.vortetos.com no longer resolves in DNS (checked live 2026-10-06) but was still in the AIOStreams URL list.
bugs.fix: Removed the URL from the AIOStreams instance list (release 5.0.58)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.58 (49a0a40), not yet confirmed inside Kodi

bugs.error_message: Review follow-up: with DMM down, unverified RD torrents counted as cached for pre-emptive termination and could stop the scrape after the first provider batch
bugs.root_cause: _prem_terminate used statistics.filtered.torrentsCached, which counts every torrentCacheSources entry including unverified=True fallbacks (pre-emptive termination is on by default, limit 5).
bugs.fix: New statistics.filtered.torrentsCachedVerified (filtered cached torrents minus unverified ones) used by _prem_terminate types 0 and 2; torrentsCached is unchanged for the window and _is_playable_source. Also added 'ts' to source_utils._VIDEO_FILE_TITLE (release 5.0.58)
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.58 (49a0a40), not yet confirmed inside Kodi

bugs.error_message: gh-pages 3cc2944 (plugin.video.prism 5.0.58) was pushed on 2026-10-06, but https://cahitcangulec.github.io/candre/addons.xml still lists 5.0.57
bugs.root_cause: GitHub Pages never started a 'pages build and deployment' run for the 3cc2944 push: GET /repos/cahitcangulec/candre/pages/builds lists only the f2630d4 build (2026-10-06T20:30Z). Why the push did not trigger a build is unknown. Publishing was manual, so nobody checked the deployed commit. Likely cause (unconfirmed): the push at 2026-10-06 21:45 UTC fell inside a GitHub 'several services degraded' incident (19:57-23:40 UTC).
bugs.fix: Deployed by hand: gh api -X POST repos/cahitcangulec/candre/pages/builds (2026-10-06 23:58:47 UTC, HTTP 201) built 3cc2944 in 23 s; since 23:59 UTC the live addons.xml lists plugin.video.prism 5.0.58 (addons.xml.md5 1aef23e379d972cb215dc53b7eef877c) and the 5.0.58 zip is served. Prevention: .github/workflows/publish-repo.yml's last step compares pages/builds/latest with the gh-pages tip and requests a Pages build (POST /pages/builds) when they differ.
bugs.status: resolved 2026-10-06 23:59 UTC (5.0.58 live after a manual Pages build request); CI guard committed on master

bugs.error_message: 5.0.58: about half of the Real-Debrid sources 'do not play' ('50/50'), while Seren 3.0.62 plays almost every click; an uncached source shows 'Failed to resolve a playable file, would you like to manually try select the file?' and answering Yes stops playback
bugs.root_cause: _fetch_source_files returned [] for an uncached hash instead of raising (upstream Prism 3fbb730 / bbviking d444784 removed Seren 3.0.62's raise), so an uncached torrent looked like 'cached, no file matched': the 30490 prompt appeared after every uncached source (the resolver window always passed allow_manual_prompt=True), and Yes re-probed, raised NoFileSelectionAvailable and broke the loop. Same path: selectFiles on magnet_conversion (starts a download), delete before unrestrict with rd.autodelete, DELETE torrents/delete/None with autodelete off, a forced token refresh after any non-2xx, no cap.
bugs.fix: 5.0.59: TorrentNotCached(ResolverFailure, persist) raised by RealDebrid.check_hash and caught in resolve_single_source before ResolverFailure -> silent skip to the next source (Seren behaviour). check_hash deletes magnet_conversion/error torrents without selectFiles, re-checks once after 1.5 s, accepts only 'downloaded', keep_torrent=True keeps the torrent until the link is unrestricted. RD's answer is stored in debridCache under 'rd' ('True' 24 h / 'False' 4 h; 429/451/503/509 and request errors are not stored). Prompt 30490 only for a cached torrent without a file match, once per play attempt; at most 10 sources per click; token refresh only on 401; delete_torrent ignores an empty id. Harness 32/32 (HEAD 11/32).
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.59 (committed on master, not pushed); confirm in Kodi

bugs.error_message: 5.0.58: DMM 'not available' hashes were stored as uncached for 4 h and hidden; a hard-coded third-party RD key was used for Torrentio without rd.auth; a url-only provider result (a4k torrentio with apikeys) raised KeyError and lost the provider's batch
bugs.root_cause: DMM is a crowd DB, so a miss there is no proof of 'uncached'; _realdebrid_worker persisted DMM negatives (checked_hashes=dmm_checked). _TIO_FALLBACK_PARAM was inherited from upstream. _process_torrent_source evaluated source['magnet'] eagerly in source.get('hash', findall(source['magnet'])[0]).
bugs.fix: 5.0.59: external answers only promote (only 'True' is persisted for RD; only the resolver's RD probe writes 'False'); the fallback key is gone and Torrentio/Comet/AIOStreams run only with the user's rd.auth; _torrent_source_hash takes hash/magnet/resolve URL and drops the key-bearing URL; opt-in rd.scraperCachedOnly passes apikeys to a4kScrapers; common.tools.log redacts debrid keys; one 'RD cache summary' info line per scrape. Harness 39/39, integration with the resolver's rows 5/5.
bugs.status: fixed in 5.0.59 (committed on master, not pushed); AllDebrid worker still hides DMM negatives (open item)

bugs.error_message: Review of the 5.0.59 working tree: RealDebrid.check_cache_batch (instantAvailability, RD error 37) and _get_url_no_refresh had no callers left; 'Resolver: none of the N tried sources' reported the capped list length even when the loop stopped early (user cancel)
bugs.root_cause: Two agents changed the scrape side (removed the only caller) and the resolver side in parallel; the log line used min(len(sources), cap) / len(sources) instead of the number of sources actually tried.
bugs.fix: Deleted check_cache_batch and _get_url_no_refresh; both log lines count the sources actually tried.

bugs.error_message: Kodi still shows Prism 5.0.58 after 5.0.59 was published; Provider Tools > Check For Updates says no updates
bugs.root_cause: Likely causes, not confirmed on the device: (1) GitHub Pages serves with Cache-Control max-age=600, and addons.xml and addons.xml.md5 are separate CDN objects updated seconds apart: a check inside that window can fetch the new md5 with a cached old addons.xml. (2) repository.candre 1.0.0 had no <checksum verify="md5">, so Kodi stored that mismatched pair and did not refresh until the md5 changed again or the repository add-on was reinstalled. (3) The CI Pages step raced GitHub's automatic Pages build (the automatic build errored as a superseded duplicate). Separately, Prism's Provider Tools > Check For Updates checks provider packages only (install_manager.check_for_updates), never plugin.video.prism, so its 'no updates' message says nothing about the Kodi repository.
bugs.fix: repository.candre 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1 adds <checksum verify="md5"> (a mismatched pair now fails the refresh and retries; the md5 URL is unchanged). publish-repo.yml's Pages step waits for GitHub's automatic Pages build (polls pages/builds/latest; requests a build only if none comes within 180 s or it errored; fails the run if the tip is not built). STATUS.md 'Kodi update rule' documents the real refresh semantics, the 10-min CDN wait and the stuck-client recovery. Committed on master, not pushed.
bugs.status: fixed on master (repository.candre 1.0.1 and the CI Pages wait), not pushed; confirm in Kodi
